summary.name: WPS AI
summary.one_liner: WPS AI is Kingsoft Office's large-language-model assistant built into WPS Office, offering AI document writing, long-text summarization, document Q&A, and PPT generation.
use_cases: Summarize long reports or academic papers
Ask questions about contents of a document
Generate Excel formulas and conditional formatting without memorizing functions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes WPS AI as a large-language-model application from Kingsoft Office offering intelligent document writing, long-text reading and processing, and human-computer interaction. Within WPS Office it lists automatic PPT generation, table analysis and processing, article rewriting and continuation, and translation. Specific features named are AI full-text summarization, which condenses long documents into abstracts, and AI document Q&A, which searches a document for answers to typed questions. It also mentions AI formula writing and AI conditional formatting in spreadsheets, where users describe what they want in plain language. The page also shows sample prompts such as year-end work summaries and training PPTs.
notable: AI full-text summarization that condenses long reports or papers into concise abstracts
AI document Q&A that answers questions by searching within the document
Natural-language AI formula and conditional formatting for spreadsheets
Web version offers only basic features
caveats: Web version only exposes basic features (page note: 网页版仅开放基础功能)
Trial rights (体验权益) are offered to some users; eligibility and validity period are covered in FAQ not shown in the page text, so paid tier terms are unclear
